Demo game changed. Jack Heart: "is thee multiagent games in ufferlib" / "maybe we need something else for hte demo. i liked hanabi but we dont do jax yet". Use Hanabi without JAX instead of a PufferLib env: OpenSpiel's C++ Hanabi through its Python bindings (pip open_spiel; PettingZoo hanabi_v5 wraps the same via Shimmy), with a PyTorch policy. Use a small configuration (fewer colors/ranks, small hands, 2 players) so training is short and local, no load. Cooperative: all seats are one team, so evaluation rows use a group for the team score. Verify the package installs on macOS arm64 and Linux before building on it; if it does not, fall back to a tiny pure-Python cooperative card game in the same spirit and say so. Same constraints as before: an example project or optional extra, not a required dependency, not in the network-denied suite. EXP-62 (PufferLib/Coworld examples) stays separate.
